LC-9(2015)/Review of Legal Dash Roary Date : 03.09.2015

fa = 9 SEP 205

To
All Additional CPFC (Zone)

Sub: -Proper entry of data in Legal Dash Board-reg.
Sir,

On analysis of data obtained from Legal Dash Board, it is found that
a large number of Prosecution cases or the cases under IPC Section 405
have been entered by the field offices in the Legal Dash Board. The
Compliance MIS Software already has a function to record the Prosecution
cases and also the cases under section 405. The Legal Cases are actually
for the recording of the cases where there is an impugned order. However
the field offices have entered the Prosecution and FIR Cases also under
Legal Dash Board. As a result the reports is generated will project wrong
data because it will also include non legal cases in the data.

By Therefore, you are requested to take necessary action to get the
data related Prosecution and the FIR Cases deleted from the legal dash
board and record the same under the correct function in the Compliance
MIS Software, or else the dash board that have been developed and are
under testing will not be able to correctly display the actual data.

ours’ faithfully,

Addl Central P. F. Commissioner(Legal)
